rationale: All 6 Jira acceptance criteria for EPMCDME-15372 pass per the acceptance lens: the guard `if (!config.baseUrl?.trim()) return;` in ensureOtlpProxy() (connect-orchestrator.ts:411-416) sits before daemonConfig/ensureDaemon, returns (never throws), and is covered by 4 new tests (undefined, empty, whitespace-only baseUrl all skip; valid baseUrl still cold-starts). The edge-case lens found zero unhandled paths — baseUrl is statically string|undefined end-to-end, so `.trim()` cannot throw, and the downstream caller (OtlpAgentAdapter.processOtlpEvent) tolerates the silent skip by design. Blind-lens notes (no debug log breadcrumb on silent skip; a comment cross-referencing connectTargets that isn't itself in this diff; the 'cold-starts normally' test only asserting spawnDaemon call-count, not daemonConfig content; the three skip-case tests not asserting full side-effect-freedom; the new @/utils/processes.js test mock's necessity being unexplained in the diff; a stale-looking last_sync_commit pointer in .state.json) are all diagnosability/test-depth/documentation nits, not defects — none contradicts the AC behavior and none is a project-guide-blocking violation. One acceptance-lens row flagged 'partial': the plan.md text (written before an earlier code-review round) says the guard condition is plain `!config.baseUrl`, but the shipped code uses `?.trim()` — a superset that also catches whitespace-only baseUrl. This is intentional: an earlier code-review finding (CR-001 in docs/superpowers/tasks/2026-10-22-epmcdme-15372-missing-baseurl-proxy-startup/code-review-final.json) identified exactly this gap and the fix-up commit (afc4a35d) added the trim; plan.md simply wasn't rewritten to match. This is a documentation-drift note, not an unmet requirement — the actual Jira ACs (all 6) pass, and the deviation makes the fix strictly safer, not weaker. Standards: all 4 commit subjects on this branch (8f59601d, afc4a35d, 992b9d6c, 7dd4a8cc) match Conventional Commits per git-workflow.md; no blocking rule in code-quality.md applies to this diff; no security-patterns.md guide exists in-repo and no concrete security issue was raised by any lens. 12 of the 14 changed files are sdlc-light process artifacts (plan/technical-analysis/qa-report/review-verdicts/state/events) with no executable surface; they were skimmed for contradiction only, per lens scope, and none was found.
